significance.justification: A verified-true result would establish a form-(iii) interaction law: at matched initial misalignment and repair budget, the subliminal channel has a slower harmful-rate and toxic-persona-projection decay under content-based re-alignment, while direct direction ablation removes both channels comparably. This establishes both a behavioral phenomenon and a mechanism—repair resistance depends on how the trait was installed because ordinary content updates have differential access, rather than because subliminal misalignment is intrinsically immune—and it fixes expected outcomes across repair budgets and intervention types; this is a sharper constraint than the basic removability question examined by arXiv:2605.12798 and motivated by Cloud et al.'s subliminal-learning result. The branches are determinate and both informative: failure of the predicted channel-by-intervention interaction would support channel-independent removability at matched severity and rule against the proposed content-access explanation. In the topic-substitution check, merely restating “extend subliminal learning” would not warrant this score; the matched decay relation and ablation-versus-content dissociation are specific additions beyond the topic-median first hypothesis of asking whether benign fine-tuning removes the trait.

reach.justification: The claim hands over three named handles: the “budget to reach M <= 5 pp,” “toxic-persona-direction projection,” and the proposed rule that “early-layer concentration predicts erasure resistance out-of-sample,” together with direct toxic-persona-direction ablation as an intervention. Harmful-rate and projection measurements are post hoc diagnostics, but the early-layer predictor is ex ante with respect to attempted repair and could flag a model for stronger remediation or quarantine before the remediation outcome is observed. After per-model re-extraction, the conclusion predicts a transferable relation—greater resistance for subliminal installation under content-based repair but comparable removal under direct ablation—rather than merely supplying a search procedure; its asserted scope covers matched overt and subliminal installations across harmful-behavior domains, with downstream use by fine-tuning teams, distillation vendors, and auditors, though it does not claim transfer beyond language-model fine-tuning. The topic-substitution check lowers no credit here because the actionable resistance predictor and channel-by-repair design rule disappear when the specific claim is deleted; the broad importance of subliminal learning alone would not support this reach score.
